purpose: Own infected health, pursuit, attack, death-to-mutagen transition and blood event facts.
state_owner: Hunger posture (stand, all fours, crawl), idle flavour, corpse feeding and the aggro scream
Colossus slam cooldown and ground wave
Body part durability, severed parts, skin wounds and corpse hit volumes
Mission-local priority queue and time/expansion budget for infected route searches
Species/action voice selection, cooldowns and chewing/agonizing sound timing
Mission-local queue of deferred enemy rig preparation
Mutation poison, lethal infection cause and collision-limited skill displacement

body_damage_v1.limb_severed: signal limb_severed(position: Vector3, direction: Vector3, excluded: Array[RID]); presentation fact like projectile_blood
body_damage_v1.severed_parts: severed parts emit projectile_blood, blood_wounded and wounded_moved facts; unsupported unused corpse/death facts are not declared
body_damage_v1.decor: public/decor/*.tscn corpses and body parts for the planner; shootable, never expire
body_damage_v1.stump_drips: bleeding stumps emit blood_wounded at the stump after 0.3 m of movement or 0.9 s

decor_pose_v1.configure_decor_pose: configure_decor_pose(config: Dictionary) -> void; before ready for parts, also retargets a ready corpse
decor_pose_v1.get_planner_bounds: get_planner_bounds() -> AABB; corpse posed and grounded local bounds; legacy returns empty
decor_pose_v1.physics_v1: Optional version1 {body:12 finite transform components, bones:bone-name->12 local transform components}; restored without simulation; old seed/pose/facing remain compatible.

decor_physics_v1.set_runtime_physics: set_runtime_physics(enabled:bool) -> void; legacy decor simulates; saved physics_v1 poses remain static and shootable
decor_physics_v1.prepare_planner_physics: prepare_planner_physics() -> void; explicitly simulate authored corpse for planner settling
decor_physics_v1.finalize_planner_physics: finalize_planner_physics() -> void; retain final local bones and dispose simulator

death_fall_v1.fall: killing blow push + 60% momentum picks death_forward|death_back|death, turns the body up to 90 degrees into the fall and slides it up to 1.8 m short of world layer 1; blood_death fires at the landing point (ADR-0034)

character_push_v1.push_strength: push_strength: float = 1.0 (Brute 2.0, Titan 2.6, Colossus 3.2); passed to push_from_character with the intended pre-slide velocity

chase_pace_v1.pace: beyond charge_distance (+1.5 m hysteresis once inside) the infected walks at walk_speed_factor; inside it sprints 2.4-4.2 s, then walks 1.1-2.2 s, repeating; within 3.5 m it always charges; speed eases at 1.4 (up) / 1.0 (down) move speeds per second; charge_distance 0 always charges (ADR-0040)

perception_v1.watch_target: watch_target(target: Node3D) -> void; the infected stays unaware (stands at its post, strolling 1-3 m in random directions) until it sees or hears the player; sight 18 m, 130 degree cone, 3.5 m all-round, blocked by walls but not glass
perception_v1.set_target: set_target(target: Node3D) -> void; forces the chase with no need to see or hear the player (spawners, summons)
perception_v1.hear_noise: hear_noise(position: Vector3, radius: float) -> void; called on group infected_alive by weapons; unaware infected within radius walk to the point, search 3.5 s and walk home if the player is not seen
perception_v1.hear_alert: hear_alert(position: Vector3, radius: float) -> void; sent by an infected that spots the player (16 m); neighbours start the chase
perception_v1.breaker_tier: export 0..2: 0 never attacks props (Hunger, Mutant), 1 smashes small props, glass and wooden partitions (Revenant, Brute), 2 smashes anything destructible (Titan, Colossus, Horde); acts when the way to the player is blocked

chase_budget_v1.configure_chase_budget: configure_chase_budget(budget: Node) -> void; bootstrap injects one mission-owned search queue
chase_budget_v1.searches_per_frame: Maximum completed local A* searches per physics frame; default 2; incremental slices share a 2000 usec soft budget and 64 expansions per tick, each search remains bounded to 192 expansions

runtime_contracts.acoustics_v1: Owner-approved 15.10.2026: opaque walls block shots and ally cries; weapon scenes export shot_noise_radius/shot_noise_interval (0.25s); hearing_profile configures rays/ear height/alert radius, hearing_range caps at 50m. Existing command signatures unchanged.

corpse_pool_v1.blood_pool_ready: signal blood_pool_ready(position: Vector3, excluded: Array[RID], death_id: int); emitted once at sampled corpse torso centre after short settling or before early removal; blood_death timing unchanged

visual_preparation_v1.configure_visual_preparation: configure_visual_preparation(budget:Node) -> void; optional mission-local queue before ready; absent queue preserves immediate setup
visual_preparation_v1.budget: public/visual_preparation_budget.gd; injected camera, track(actor), <=1 animation/body-parts phase/frame within40m, <=64 weak references scanned/frame. Damage and required attack timing prepare synchronously.

mutation_status_v2.apply_skill_push: apply_skill_push(direction:Vector3,distance:float) -> void; actual metres, stops at collision, cancels attack windup
mutation_status_v2.apply_skill_infection: apply_skill_infection(duration:float,damage_per_second:float) -> void; poison lethal damage only explodes40 within4m once, no propagated infection

runtime_contracts.enemy_gameplay_modes_v1: Bootstrap-owned transient metadata on injected target: {ignore_player:bool,no_damage:bool}; missing=false. Infected reads at sensing/attack time, applies live and to late spawns; ADR0059. No dependency edge or map DTO change.
